description: Proposes a text change on a page without editing it: an anchor (exact visible text) plus a replacement. The change is applied only when the page owner accepts it (as a new attributed version). Same permissions as outbox_create_comment.

exact.description: Exact visible text to replace; it must appear literally in the page (max 2000)

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key (Idempotency-Key header). It prevents a duplicate only if outbox_capabilities lists this operation in features.idempotencyEndpoints. Omitted = generated

prefix.description: Context right before `exact`, to disambiguate repeated text

replacement.description: New text; inserted HTML-escaped (no markup), max 8000

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

suffix.description: Context right after `exact`, to disambiguate repeated text

name: outbox_create_suggestion
title: Outbox: suggest a text change
